author: 2BJ
body:
> http://youtu.be/qwfprhsoGeo (Video's being processed, it should work in about 10 minutes...)

> 0.25 - 0.40 - slowed down (x2) - builds across the void 3 times faster than other players, without having to shift at all.
↪ > 0.25 - He's clearly standing over the edge of the block, but somehow doesn't fall into the void. 
     > 0.31 - He's standing over the sides of the blocks, but still doesn't fall into the void. 

> 1.07 - 1.11 - normal speed - Is able to build to the monument in less then 5 seconds, without having to shift or stop at all.

> 1.57 - 2.03 - normal speed - Is able to build to the second monument in less then 5 seconds, again, and without having to shit or stop all.
 
"Breezily Bridging" 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9lqyICJz1AE 
(This video isn't mine, but I'm pretty sure that the mod used in this video is the one DemStrafez was using.)
